title: Experiment envelope
description: Shared provenance fields for the shogiesa -> quietset -> lineprior -> veridict pipeline (shogiesa generates teacher observations, quietset scores stability/reliability, lineprior predicts gate-evaluation priority, veridict makes the final judgment). This file is vendored IDENTICALLY into all four repos -- not a shared library, just the same JSON Schema copied into each one -- so a record's provenance survives moving between them. ASSUMPTION (unconfirmed as of this writing -- flag to a human before treating it as settled): shogiesa's copy was authored fresh for this round, not copied from an existing sibling-repo schema, since none of quietset/lineprior/veridict were visible from the session that wrote it. All fields are optional: shogiesa (and presumably each sibling) only populates the subset relevant to what it produces.

experiment_id.description: Opaque identifier for the overall experiment run, supplied by the orchestrator. Not interpreted by any one repo.

candidate_id.description: Opaque identifier for the candidate engine/model/config under evaluation.

baseline_id.description: Opaque identifier for the baseline being compared against.

lineage_id.description: Opaque identifier grouping a chain of related experiments (e.g. successive iterations of the same candidate).

dataset_sha256.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex, verifiable with `shasum -a 256`) of the raw bytes of the dataset file this stage consumed or produced.

split_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the split-assignment artifact in use, if any. shogiesa treats this as opaque passthrough -- it cannot itself determine whether a given input file 'is a split'.

teacher_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 identifying the upstream teacher-generation run manifest (i.e. a shogiesa `label --manifest` output) this stage's input was derived from, if any.

binary_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the engine/model binary used to produce this stage's output.

weight_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the NNUE/eval weight file the engine was configured to use, distinct from binary_sha256 when weights are loaded from a separate file rather than compiled into the binary.

init_seed.description: Seed governing initialization (e.g. weight init) upstream of this stage. Opaque passthrough for shogiesa.

split_seed.description: Seed governing the train/eval split assignment. Opaque passthrough for shogiesa.

shuffle_seed.description: Seed governing this dataset's shuffle/permutation order (shogiesa's `shuffle --seed`).

schema_version.description: The data schema version this record/manifest was produced under (shogiesa's SCHEMA_VERSION).

validity.description: Opaque validity tag for this stage's output (e.g. "valid"/"invalid"/"pending"). Type chosen as a plain string since no repo in this pipeline interprets it as a closed enum yet -- confirm against what quietset/lineprior/veridict actually emit before relying on specific values.
